items.summary:
Check out God's Eye View:
https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
https://www.spatialintelligence.ai/

What if you could turn your computer into a spy movie command center using real-world data? I sat down with Bilawal Sidhu to explore God's Eye View, his open-source tool that brings flights, satellites, ships, traffic, and more into one interactive 3D globe.

We dive into how he built it with AI, try out its voice controls, and explore everything from military flight data to public traffic cameras and NASA fire detections. Bilawal also shows how people are using it to reconstruct real-world events, and I walk through getting it running on your own computer.

The project is open source, and many of the data sources are free for personal use. Some features require API keys, and voice interaction or heavier usage can add costs.

items.title: Did AI Doom Us All?
items.summary:
Are all of these AI safety campaigns part of a big coordinated psyop?

Apparently some people are actually being paid to push anti-AI messaging, but I’m not sure if that’s the case in these recent instances. 

I think it’s more likely that these Anthropic and OpenAI whistleblowers are usually from the alignment and safety sector, so their entire job is to study potential worst-case scenarios. Spending every day inside that world probably changes how you see the risks, but it also means they may be noticing dangers the rest of us aren’t.

I’m inclined to believe their warnings are genuine, but I don’t think panic is the answer. 

The AI arms race probably isn’t slowing down anytime soon. So maybe the smartest move is putting more brainpower into alignment and not just shareholder value.

What do you think: genuine warning or manufactured fear?

#AI #AInews #anthropic #openai #aisafety
